description: This file implements a socket server for handling client connections, message sending and receiving, and processing command-response protocols in C++. It includes socket setup, threading, and message parsing logic as part of a network communication module.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a response message containing a channel ID and JSON payload.

classes.name: SocketServer
classes.description: Implements a TCP socket server that manages client connections, message exchanges, and server lifecycle.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes and starts listening on a specified IP address and port, setting a callback for incoming responses.

methods.name: RunThread
methods.description: Starts the server run loop in a dedicated thread.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main server loop handling incoming connection requests and data reception.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes server and client sockets, shutting down the server.

methods.name: SendInvoke
methods.description: Sends an invoke command with a channel ID, token, and JSON payload to the client.

methods.name: SendAttach
methods.description: Sends an attach or detach command along with a channel ID.

methods.name: SendExit
methods.description: Sends an exit command to the client to terminate the session.

methods.name: ReadResponse
methods.description: Reads a response message from the client, parsing the header and JSON payload.
